hooks.text: 先选拥有独立牌组、被动和终极技的主英雄，击败区域 Boss 后再招募支援英雄，特殊搭配会生成阵营英雄卡。
hooks.excerpt: Before embarking on the journey, players select an initial Hero with a unique Deck, Passive, and Ultimate Skill. After defeating an Area Boss and clearing the map, players can upgrade their Hero’s Passive or Ultimate, then select an additional Supporting Hero to call on their abilities during battles. Special pairings between Heroes create a Faction-specific Hero Card.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战场分为攻击、防御和速度三区，技能卡只有放进对应颜色区域才会触发效果。
hooks.excerpt: Battles are divided into three actionable zones: Attack (red), Defense (blue), and Speed (green). Skill Card effects trigger only when placed into their corresponding Zones, requiring careful strategy to optimize each play.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 动态生成的遭遇、事件和奖励会持续改变牌组与策略，成功通图还能留下跨局成长。
hooks.excerpt: Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey incorporates roguelite design through per-run progression, procedural variation, and meta-progression that persists across successful map completions. Each run features dynamically generated encounters, events, and rewards that shape the player’s deck composition and influence their strategy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
